rationale: RSD2 pin (2026-09-05): the old payload attach guarded on `!metadata.errors` — ANY parse error in the file wiped qualified_calls from EVERY function (4,620 functions across 519 error files in cargo+ripgrep). clean_caller shares a file with a deliberately broken fn (error at L15); its payload must still contain `helper`. Error recovery for a single bad token is precise enough that per-symbol direct attach never misattributes.

expectSymbols.name: broken
expectSymbols.comment: symbol still declared even though its body has a parse error

expectQualifiedCalls.comment: RSD2: payload survives a parse error elsewhere in the file
